text:
That text about a traffic violation is probably a scam
It starts with a text message with a QR code. The message says you need to scan it to pay for a traffic violation to avoid court.
The text might look official with a seal from whatever state it claims to be from and a (fake) case number.
A hearing date, a hearing time, a payment amount.
The texts will include a list of bad things that could happen if you don't pay. The scammers will threaten things like default judgments, fines, and enforcement actions.
If you get a text like this, don't respond, and don't scan the QR code.
